annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communication (Learning Corner)
annotation.summary_en: EU Learning Corner landing page presenting the European Commission's ethical guidelines for educators on using AI and data in teaching and learning. It describes the guidelines' contents (examples, ethical principles and requirements, new competences, AI terminology) and links to the PDF and a video; the guidelines' text itself is not reproduced.
key_provisions_or_claims: Page promotes EU ethical guidelines for educators on AI and data use in education.
Guidelines cover ethical principles, requirements and new competences for AI use.
Notes AI offers educational opportunities but lacks detailed impact assessments and raises ethical concerns.
Encourages teachers to use the guidelines and share them with parents.
annotation.title_clean: Etikai iránymutatások oktatók számára a mesterséges intelligencia (MI) és az adatok oktatási és tanulási célú felhasználásáról
annotation.title_en: Ethical guidelines for educators on using artificial intelligence (AI) and data in teaching and learning
